cohort.selection: Exclude every prior Hotpot128 ID, then take the first 256 IDs sorted by SHA256(prefix + ID); no question, answer, difficulty or outcome filtering.
cohort.role: New externally authored, previously uninspected selection for this round; the source corpus is the previously used HotpotQA distractor dev corpus.
cohort.privacy: Publish only IDs, hashes, counts and source-free metrics. Questions, answers, original text and raw native payloads remain in ignored local files. Do not send individual cases or results to implementation agents.

components.packing: The unchanged shared_response and whole-block first-fit packer from benchmarks.component_eval/token_compare; one fixed page corpus, citation format and top-five limit for all rankers.
components.native_read_policy: For ai-memory, read every mapped top-five page on repetition 0 and verify exact original bytes. Report this declared search-plus-all-reads cost separately from search and common harness packing. Other components have no additional native read calls in this experiment.
components.boundary: Executed native retrieval components only. Book includes its Python context assembly; claude-mem includes native SQLite FTS and Bun bridge; ai-memory uses its HTTP/MCP local hybrid; billion-context uses its search kernel and Node bridge. Same host does not make these whole-product latency boundaries equivalent.

common.query_permutation: random.Random(23017 + 1009 * repetition).shuffle; identical order for every engine
common.optional_semantic: Bind enabled/disabled and the candidate commit before the first heldout score. If enabled, use the already pinned local multilingual MiniLM model and the candidate's committed semantic policy; no generation calls.

metrics.group_policy: Compute group membership with the frozen baseline's term analysis and source hierarchy, once before any scored call; labels never enter ranking or indexing.
tokens: exact cl100k_base and o200k_base final context
resources: sampled worker-plus-descendant RSS peak at 20ms interval, separately for setup and queries
state directory bytes excluding symlinked model caches

execution.measurement_host: All engine stages run sequentially in one Linux job; each engine has an independent worker and state. No concurrent CPU benchmark. Record one run host identity plus each engine process metadata.
execution.ledger: Write a started intent and finished source-free sample for every query/repetition. Preserve failures and interrupted intents. Persist each completed stage to a dedicated validation result branch before the next stage.
execution.recovery: No implicit replay of an existing measurement. A completed identical stage may be verified and reused only with its original host attribution; a different host starts a distinct performance run and is never pooled.
execution.freeze_gate: No worker may score until both the cohort manifest and candidate binding are committed, their file hashes match the binding, and both runtime source hashes match their pinned commits.
execution.failures: Missing engines, budgets, repetitions, queries, failed requests or invariant violations prevent a complete validation status. Preserve negative quality outcomes; passing integrity is not a quality improvement.

interpretation: The 256 IDs are disjoint from the prior 128, but come from the same external encyclopedia corpus. This tests a new selection, not new-domain conversational-memory generalization.
All HotpotQA cases are answerable; this cohort does not measure abstention or hallucination.
Retain every supplied distractor paragraph and every selected query, including structurally difficult or unattainable evidence labels.
After the first scored run, this cohort becomes regression data. Do not tune a policy from these outcomes and relabel another run as the same heldout validation.
This round performs retrieval and resource measurements only; it does not replay prior generated-answer or complete model-workflow experiments.
RSS sampling is a lower-bound observation; summing process RSS may count shared mappings more than once. It is not unique physical memory or a provider bill.
